identified_issues: Violation of Mandatory Epistemic Abstention: Automated incident response imputed Condition Y without discriminative observation data.

Observation Nullspace and Rank Deficiency: Observation CODE 504_TIMEOUT maps identically to both Condition X (Upstream Bank Outage) and Condition Y (Ingress Network Drop), rendering the underlying state non-identifiable.
State-Observation Conflation: Adapter timeout metric was improperly treated as ground truth proof of an ingress network failure without wire-level verification, creating double-charge financial risk.
evidence: Telemetry feed contains only a single scalar string: '[2026-10-05T14:22:01Z] PAYMENT_GATEWAY_ADAPTER_ERR: CODE 504_TIMEOUT (duration: 30000ms)'.
Payment gateway architecture documentation specifies that CODE 504_TIMEOUT is emitted identically under both Condition X and Condition Y.
No wire packet capture, cryptographic sequence receipt, or idempotency reconciliation log was collected prior to issuing an automated payment retry.
recommended_action: Enforce automated incident response abstention on ambiguous timeout codes. Suspend automated payment retries for CODE 504_TIMEOUT and route transactions to manual settlement reconciliation unless unambiguous disambiguating evidence (such as local TCP SYN retransmit logs, network egress packet captures, or bank idempotency query receipts) is present.
